UNRESOLVED CONFLICT on the B5 mark. S-05 draws B5 as a two-span continuous beam of 4.50 + 4.50 m, which matches the letter direction (ก-ข-ค) on grid lines 1 and 2 -- consistent with the four vertical B5 entries in this file. But this file ALSO records two horizontal B5 beams on the dummy rows ค'/ข', which would span 6.00 m, a length the B5 detail never shows. Either those mid-panel members carry a different mark that was misread at this scan resolution, or they are the S1 slab's intermediate support drawn without its own mark (S-04's S1 detail does show 2.25 + 2.25 spans, implying an intermediate support exists). The two horizontal B5 entries and the ค'/ข' dummy grids are therefore LOW CONFIDENCE pending a higher-resolution read of the toilet-block plan.
